_original_lore: It can take years for Hellwisp to
create a pearl, but the Matriarch
secretes so much fluid that it can
make multiple of those pearls every
name: 重型珍珠

source: It can take years for Hellwisp to
create a pearl, but the Matriarch
secretes so much fluid that it can
make multiple of those pearls every
loreParagraphs.translation: 地狱火精灵可能需要数年才能产出一颗珍珠,但母体分泌的液体如此之多,以至于它每天都能产出多颗这样的珍珠.
